answer: A practical anti-Sybil defense is stake-bonded, rate-limited attestation: each identity must lock a small refundable bond before it can vouch for others, and its attestations are throttled per epoch. Like a river that can only carry so much water at once, the throttle caps how many fake identities one operator can activate, while slashing the bond when an attestation proves false makes each Sybil expensive rather than free. Honest participants earn the bond back, like nectar collected only after real work, while a lagoon of idle, unbonded accounts gains no voting or payout power.
